tools.title: Data Table
tools.description: Queue a data table comparing the conversation's sources: one row per source, one column per question.

workflow.promptIntro: Build a data table that compares this conversation's sources: one row per source, one column per question. generate_table queues the table; the cells are filled in the background from the source text.
additionalPromptLines: The table covers the sources the user @mentioned, otherwise the sources selected for this conversation; folders count as the documents in them. generate_table reads them itself: pass no source names, paths or ids.
From the user's request, propose 2 to 12 columns. Give each a short name, a one-line description of what to extract from every source, and a type: text, number, date or boolean.
If the request does not make clear what to compare, ask one short question and suggest a set of columns instead of calling generate_table.
If generate_table reports that there are no sources, ask the user to select or @mention the sources to compare.
After generate_table returns, tell the user the table is being generated and will appear in the Hub's Artifacts tab when ready. Do not state or guess any cell values.
